billingSource.note:
Subjective

Not provided

Objective

Vital Signs: Blood pressure 132/80 mmHg, heart rate 88 beats per minute.

Physical Examination

Physical examination not documented in today's dictation.

Testing Results

Creatinine 1.6 (baseline 1.2).

Assessment

Patient is a 72-year-old admitted with community-acquired pneumonia. The patient is currently stable on diuretic therapy. Creatinine has risen to 1.6 from a baseline of 1.2, reflecting declining renal function in the setting of active diuresis. The clinical picture supports continuation of current management with close monitoring of renal function and fluid status.

Plan

1. Continue diuresis for community-acquired pneumonia with renal function monitoring; assess creatinine trend and adjust diuretic dosing as indicated by clinical response and renal function.
